_note: The two expensive ways out of a negative encaisse (#159), as Étienne decided them on October 16, 2026. The engine brings loanEvent, Mme Prudhomme's emergency loan, the first morning the encaisse closed below zero, once per game year of 365 days from day 0; she refuses while an earlier emergency loan is still open, and at the difficulties of noSecondLoanAt once there was one. investorEvent, Max Duvent's offer, comes the morning she refuses, or investorDaysAfterLoan days after her last loan if the encaisse is still below zero, for maxShareRounds rounds at most. appointmentEvent, Mme Prudhomme's appointment card (#164), comes the morning after a trip to the Caisse instead, when she would lend and the loan would be above zero, unless the encaisse closed below zero and the morning brings her or Max Duvent as above; it counts as her visit of the game year. All three cards have a weight of 0, so no draw brings them; their terms, the loan's amount, rate, term and fee and the share sold and its price, are their effects' in events.json. Six whole calendar months in a row with the encaisse below zero at every close end the game, at the close of the sixth month's last day, as Étienne decided on October 16, 2026 (#160): a month the encaisse went below zero after its 1st does not count, and a close at zero or above starts the count again. Mme Prudhomme's letters warn of it, each the morning after the close that reaches its afterMonths, or the first morning after with no other card while the months last.
